mapper.insert: INSERT INTO stories ( user_id, image_url, created_at, expires_at, deleted_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{imageUrl}, SYSTIMESTAMP, SYSTIMESTAMP + INTERVAL '24' HOUR, NULL )
mapper.select: SELECT STORY_ID, USER_ID, IMAGE_URL, CREATED_AT, EXPIRES_AT, DELETED_AT FROM STORIES WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND STORY_ID = #{storyId} AND DELETED_AT IS NULL AND EXPIRES_AT > SYSTIMESTAMP

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.user_id) FROM stories s JOIN follows f ON f.following_user_id = s.user_id AND f.follower_user_id = #{userId} JOIN users u ON u.user_id = s.user_id AND u.delete_at IS NULL WHERE s.deleted_at IS NULL AND s.expires_at > SYSTIMESTAMP

SELECT s.story_id AS storyId, s.user_id AS userId, s.image_url AS imageUrl, CASE WHEN sv.view_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS isRead, s.created_at AS createdAt, s.expires_at AS expiresAt, s.deleted_at AS deletedAt FROM stories s LEFT JOIN story_views sv ON sv.story_id = s.story_id AND sv.user_id = #{viewerId} WHERE s.user_id = #{userId} AND s.deleted_at IS NULL AND s.expires_at > SYSTIMESTAMP ORDER BY s.created_at ASC

SELECT u.user_id AS userId, u.username AS username, u.profile_img AS profileImg FROM users u JOIN ( SELECT s.user_id, MIN(CASE WHEN sv.view_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS group_read_order, MAX(s.created_at) AS latest_story_created_at, MAX(sv.created_at) AS latest_viewed_at FROM stories s JOIN follows f ON f.following_user_id = s.user_id AND f.follower_user_id = #{viewerId} LEFT JOIN story_views sv ON sv.story_id = s.story_id AND sv.user_id = #{viewerId} WHERE s.deleted_at IS NULL AND s.expires_at > SYSTIMESTAMP GROUP BY s.user_id ) story_group ON story_group.user_id = u.user_id WHERE u.delete_at IS NULL ORDER BY story_group.group_read_order ASC, CASE WHEN story_group.group_read_order = 0 THEN story_group.latest_story_created_at END DESC, CASE WHEN story_group.group_read_order = 1 THEN story_group.latest_viewed_at END DESC, u.user_id ASC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY
